description: What a Trails event records from a request: requestParameters (path, query, then the parameters an endpoint sets; secrets hidden) and, when an endpoint sets none, defaultRequestParameters (path and query values, then only the body's top-level field names with their values hidden, and nothing from the body of a refused call) and a successful write's responseElements (identifiers id, slug, name, resourceName, prefix, expiresAt at the top level or one object down, plus the fields the endpoint's catalog entry lists). [being built] directoryActivity: the SSO IdP's scoped exception. grantedInternalCalls: the /internal/* calls served through a customer's grant, recorded by the serving product as a ServiceEvent invoked by the calling namespace, once a customer's grant authorized and the product served the call; null means not recorded. grantedInvokedFor: what such an event keeps of a consumer-supplied invokedFor (only the string keys principalId and type; null means left out). ingestKeyInternalCalls: the only other recorded /internal/* call, obs-api's ensure when it creates a dataset for a project ingest key, recorded by obs-api as an ApiCall with the key's IngestKey identity, or [being built] for an internal producer (producer, a namespace obs allows, instead of ingestKeyId), recorded as a ServiceEvent invoked by the producer's namespace; null means not recorded. [being built] The cases with a job: obs-worker's servicesync cataloging a service key obs ingest saw, recorded as an ApiCall with the sending key's IngestKey identity, or as a ServiceEvent invoked by obs itself when that key is no longer known or isn't a valid key ID; null means not recorded. [being built] readOnly: whether an endpoint's events are readOnly: a GET (and HEAD), and a computation POST (idempotencyException computation) unless it records per JSON-RPC method, whose methods may act. A computation still records its successful answer's identifiers in responseElements. [being built] acmeBinding: Private CA's ACME identity (contracts/trails.md, "ACME bindings"): identities builds it from the binding owner's identity, as org-api's principal-batch answer names it, and the binding's eab_ slug (null: no identity, the owner isn't a user, the root user or a bot, or the slug isn't one); valid and invalid are userIdentity values the schema accepts and refuses. [being built] s3AccessKey: Object Storage's S3 identity (contracts/trails.md, "S3 access keys"), shaped like acmeBinding, with key the access key's oak_ ID. [being built] delegatedCalls: a receiver's delegated call (contracts/trails.md, "Delegated calls"): orgApi is org-api's answer to the delegated check (as delegated-checks.json receiverMapping), receiverStatus the receiver's answer, recorded whether the receiver records it, and, when it does, userIdentity (org-api's answerIdentity with invokedBy <caller>.ezghcloud.com, as the delegated answer gives it) and userAgent. A case with earlier lists the org-api answers of the call's earlier delegated checks (each allowed): a refusal of the delegation itself after them is still not recorded; whether the call is recorded is decided by the answer that ended it.

defaultRequestParameters.name: path and query values, then the body's top-level field names, each hidden
no body value is recorded, however its key is spelled or nested
a body field never replaces a path or query value
a refused call records nothing from its body
the backstop catches key material in a query however it's spelled
a query's secret-looking keys are hidden

responseElements.name: an operation (202): its id, plus the listed target
nothing identifying at the top: one object down
